title: Haye abid e bimar
body:
BAQIR KE LABON PAR HAI YE NALA MERE BABA
KYU HAMKO GAYE CHORH KE TANHA MERE BABA
YE DAGH YATIMI KA HAI SAHENA BADA DUSHWAR -
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
JO SAIYADE SAJJAD THA DUNIYA CHALA HAI
GHAMGIN NAMAZE HAI TO SAJDO ME BUKA HAI
HAMRAH MUSALLE KE HAIN GIRYA DARO DIWAR -
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
ZAINAB KI ASIRI KA LIYE DAGH JIGAR PE
CHALIS BARAS KHUN NA RUKA ANKHUON SE JISKE
TADPATA RAHA JISKO SADA SHAM KA BAZAR –
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
SINE ME BANAYE HUWE MASUM KI TURBAT
JO BHOOL NA PAYA KABHI HAMSHIR KI GHURBAT
GARDAN ME RASAN ZAKHMI LAWEN KHUN BHARE RUKHSAR –
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
SADMA YE PAYAMBAR saww KE JIGAR SE KOI PUCHE
PHIR EK JANAZA UTHA SADAT KE GHAR SE
SAR PEET KE KARTE HAIN BUKA SARE AZADAR –
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
BABA KO LITANE LAGE JAB QABR KE ANDAR
YAD AA GAYA BAQIR as WO ZINDAN KA MANZAR
HAMSHIR KI MAIYAT LIYE EK BEKASO LACHAR –
HAY ABIDE BIMAR ×2
